text:
tom.releases: deploybot just fired a p95 alert on /v1/embed in prod-usw2. Suggests autorevert to previous image.

deploybot: [ALERT] route=/v1/embed env=prod-usw2 p95=1.9s threshold=1.2s action=suggest_autorevert tags=kvcache,kernel-flag

elaine.sre: Seeing small bump in 5xx (~0.3%) and a handful of kvcache eviction traces. This lines up with the kernel-flag flip from the last release.
dev-ops: If it's kernel-flag related, autorevert might oscillate with the canary. Prefer manual intervention.

harry.prod: Agreed. Customer-facing endpoints are sensitive; we should pin and rollback to v2.2.9 (last known good). Can someone run the rollback job?

dev-ops: Rollback plan: 1) pin v2.2.9 in console 2) drain new instances 3) run rollback job for pool=public-infer-usw2 4) monitor p95/5xx for 20m 5) update release notes + notify partners.

support-bot: Suggested command: `./ops/run rollback --env=prod-usw2 --pool=public-infer-usw2 --target-version=v2.2.9 --drain-seconds=90`

tom.releases: I'll get pin set and coordinate comms. Elaine, can you lead the bridge?

elaine.sre: On it. Pinning now.
dev-ops: Pin completed (req id: d5b7). Throttling rollout slice for v2.4.1 to 0. Starting rollback job.

support-bot: rollback job started id=rj-20260305-042 status=in_progress. Notifying #support and #customers-dedicated.

harry.prod: Draft message for support to send to Dedicated customers: "We detected increased latency for the embedding endpoint after a recent rollout. We've reverted to a stable version and are investigating. No data exposure. We'll post updates within 4 hours." Approve?

tom.releases: Looks good. Add that we're throttling and monitoring.

elaine.sre: Progress: drain successful on 10/10 instances, avg drain 38s. p95 down to 0.95s, 5xx back to baseline ~0.02%.

dev-ops: Rollback job rj-20260305-042 completed successfully end_ts=1769050075. All traffic on v2.2.9.

support-bot: Notified stakeholders. Ticket created: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-78

harry.prod: Follow-ups: - Add kernel-flag toggle to canary gating - Disable auto-autorevert for this rollout window - Create postmortem ticket and assign to tom.releases
tom.releases: I'll open the PM ticket and add notes. Support to send out the customer blurb. Elaine continue monitoring for 1h then hand off.

elaine.sre: Monitoring for 60m. Will escalate if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Thread will be closed after final customer notifications confirmed."
